video_title: LeBron SIGNS With Philly! Why Didn’t He Return To Miami + What’s Next For The Lakers?

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Joel Embiid faces increased pressure to be a championship contender
quotes.excerpt: There's never been pressure on Joel Embiid to be a championship contender more than it is this year
quotes.quote: There's never been pressure on Joel Embiid to be a championship contender more than it is this year and next year.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Philadelphia is a top-three team in terms of offseason aggression
quotes.excerpt: If you were talking about some of the most aggressive teams when it came to this summer's free agency
quotes.quote: If you were talking about some of the most aggressive teams when it came to this summer's free agency, you would say Philly might be top three with Toronto and Miami, and maybe Minnesota. So with that attitude, you go, let's look top to bottom. They're ready to win. Do they have star power? For sure. Do they have great guards? Yep. Do you have a great big man, when healthy, and Joel Embiid, you got to think, I think last year was the first year he hadn't played with a knee brace in almost seven years or six years. So you would hope his health is getting better.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' family and inner circle are excellent at keeping things in-house
quotes.excerpt: People always underestimate how well they keep things in house, LeBron and his family
quotes.quote: People always underestimate how well they keep things in house, LeBron and his family, wherever he's going to go. I think L.A. was probably the closest one ever that people kind of felt like he was going to go to L.A. when he was leaving Cleveland. There was there was kind of that that vibe, but no one knew 100%.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: A player's legacy should be defined by winning championships
quotes.excerpt: Your legacy should be winning. Everybody, oh, you did it with one team, or you did this
quotes.quote: Your legacy should be winning. Everybody, oh, you did it with one team, or you did this, or blah, blah. Your legacy should be winning. I did see something, I don't remember who said it, they're like, you're not ring chasing if you bring the ring.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Rings are not given out in the offseason
quotes.excerpt: There's still a lot of work to be done. Rings aren't given out in the offseason.
quotes.quote: There's still a lot of work to be done. Rings aren't given out in the offseason. If this Philly team is healthy, if Joel Embiid has 70% health and it can be on the floor throughout the postseason, if their team has a level of health, and that goes to every team in the league. But I would say this, if they are healthy, if you have the wings, Jaylen Brown and Bron, if you have VJ, if you have a level of health, let's say that the Knicks had, that the Knicks had. If you have a level of health that San Antonio had, if you have that, I can see Philly being right there in the end with a chance to win a championship.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Boston would not have traded Jaylen Brown if LeBron was on the team
quotes.excerpt: Boston would have never traded Jaylen Brown to the 76ers if LeBron was on the team.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: Allie, think about this, or Richard, Boston would have never traded Jaylen Brown to the 76ers if LeBron was on the team. They would have never just basically put them in a situation like that.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Joel Embiid's contract was considered untradeable until recently
quotes.excerpt: People were saying Joel Embiid's contract is one of the most untradeable things in the league.
quotes.quote: People were saying Joel Embiid's contract is one of the most untradeable things in the league. They were saying Jaylen Brown is this and that, and he's not a good teammate, and all of a sudden, all that goes out the window when you get a 42-year-old LeBron, and now you guys are this like all-winning team. It's just like, it's amazing how the narrative changes.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse is a beast at managing team personalities
quotes.excerpt: Nick Nurse, one thing that's not taking into consideration is Nick Nurse is a beast.
quotes.quote: Nick Nurse, one thing that's not taking into consideration is Nick Nurse is a beast. And so when you add all these personalities to a team, Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey, you know, Bron, VJ, you know, Jaylen Brown, you need a coach that can handle all that, that's going to put them in the right situation. A lot of them, everyone's going to talk about usage rate, but Nick Nurse made it work in Toronto with, you know, OG Anunoby, Pascal Siakam, Kyle Lowry, and Kawhi Leonard. Now obviously those teams aren't as comparable, but you would say maybe they are a little bit more comparable than you think.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James moves the needle regardless of where he goes
quotes.excerpt: The goalposts move every time he makes a decision.
quotes.quote: The goalposts move every time he makes a decision. If he would have went to Golden State, it'll gross. If he would have went to a Cavs, oh, he's stacking teams. Let's say he went to Houston, oh, you're stacking teams. So no matter what decision he makes, half of the people are going to think it's bullshit anyway. So you might as well do what you want. And that's what he's doing. So his legacy, what you going to do? You can't argue with numbers and facts. And no player has moved the needle for as many teams as he has in his career, and that's a fact.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Robert Parish played until 43 and was still a championship contender
quotes.excerpt: Robert Parish was 41 in NBA. Nobody was caring where Robert Parish was going.
quotes.quote: Robert Parish was 41 in NBA. Nobody was caring where Robert Parish was going. It wasn't like, oh, where Robert Parish going to go? When he gets on your team, he's a championship contender.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Knicks were the only team that defended Joel Embiid well
quotes.excerpt: The Knicks were the only team that went at Joel Embiid defensively.
quotes.quote: The Knicks were the only team that went at Joel Embiid defensively, right? Now obviously that's a health thing, obviously that's mobility, but the Knicks are built to go at Joel Embiid where these other teams are like, how do we guard him? The Knicks are like, well, we have two or three guys that can guard him as best as we can.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James and Jaylen Brown are both workhorses
quotes.excerpt: Think about a whole season when you got a guy like Jaylen Brown who obviously takes care of his body
quotes.quote: Think about a whole season when you got a guy like Jaylen Brown who obviously takes care of his body, doesn't really have big injuries, knock on wood, ever in his career. He's a workhorse. Then you add LeBron James, another workhorse. So instead of just having Tyrese Maxey be that guy that comes into the gym and works out every day, you have two more guys building a culture of, we're trying to get better every single day.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Minnesota is a top contender for the next two years
quotes.excerpt: I think in the next two years for sure they are. For sure Philly. But for the long run
quotes.quote: I think in the next two years for sure they are. For sure Philly. But for the long run of my organization, Philly, for the next two years, because they're going for a chip. Minnesota is like, what can we do for our future and to keep Anthony Edwards? I think getting LaMelo Ball for what they did really is going to revamp that team and make them even more exciting to play with over the next five to ten years because they'll be able to retain some of these great players.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown will be an All-Star caliber player for five more years
quotes.excerpt: They added a first team All-NBA player who will be All-Star caliber for five more years.
quotes.quote: They added a first team All-NBA player who will be All-Star caliber for five more years. So they got the short term, they got Anthony Simons. So they got shooting and scoring off the bench. They got KCP, they got they got shooting and defense off the bench. You add Dean Wade, they've got they've got another defensive hybrid four-five guy that can knock down shots.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Lakers have a core but need to round out their roster
quotes.excerpt: When you're building around Luka, who's one of the top five players on the planet, Austin Reaves
quotes.quote: When you're building around Luka, who's one of the top five players on the planet, Austin Reaves, you've added him. So they have their core. Now they've got to figure out the puzzle pieces around them. And I do believe they have picks still that they they have available if they want to, you know, if a rolling big comes in, a lob threat of a big comes in. There's different options, but are the Lakers in that mix this year? No. Are they two years away from, because it takes time to build a championship roster. Yes. Do they have that window of time with Luka? Yes, they have that window of time. They got a decade with Luka as a top ten player on the planet given health, given all these things. So they have a window.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Winning teams become performance-based
quotes.excerpt: Once you're trying to win, everyone becomes performance-based.
quotes.quote: Once you're trying to win, everyone becomes performance-based. And so I think now where Dallas is, they're more in a performance-based space, which I think benefits all the young players.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Lakers need to find shooters to space the floor
quotes.excerpt: They need to go find shooters. Spacing so that Bam and a Giannis can get downhill
quotes.quote: They need to go find shooters. Spacing so that Bam and a Giannis can get downhill and create for other people. But until then, I don't necessarily like this roster. I don't think it's complete, and they got to go find somebody or they might, yeah, they might go to Europe, they go get some shooters. They might go get somebody from, you know, from Greece and stuff.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson and Allie Clifton discuss their 3-point contest performance
quotes.excerpt: I was a part of the 3-point contest, the actual one, years ago and the same thing happened.

text_blocks.speaker: Allie Clifton
text_blocks.text: Shout out to Kelsey Plum. She is obviously a baller, we all know Kelsey Plum. But I went up to her and I was like, what were you thinking? And she was like, Allie, I was a part of the 3-point contest, the actual one, years ago and the same thing happened. She goes, I'm not a rack shooter.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: And I'm like, I get it. I'm not a WNBA player, I've never made it to this level.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Allie Clifton and Richard Jefferson compare their 3-point contest scores
quotes.excerpt: They were like, no, no, you beat Richard's point total.

text_blocks.speaker: Allie Clifton
text_blocks.text: When it was all said and done, they came up to me and I thought they were going to compliment me for beating Kelsey Plum and they were like, no, no, you beat Richard's point total.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: Yeah, what was my point total?

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson claims victory over Kelsey Plum in 3-point contest
quotes.excerpt: As far as I'm concerned I beat Kelsey Plum also.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: As far as I'm concerned I beat Kelsey Plum also. So we're, as a, you know, it's all on a sliding scale between professional and non-professional. So she's a professional, I'm not one. So technically, we beat Kelsey Plum.
